items.headline: Rams suffer several major injuries, including to WR Adams, who's out 6-10 weeks
items.description: Rams wideout Davante Adams ruptured a hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Cardinals, and he will be sidelined for six to 10 weeks, coach Sean McVay announced.

items.headline: Rams place kicker Blake Grupe on IR due to knee injury
items.description: The Rams have placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve after he injured his right knee in the team's Week 6 loss to the Cardinals.
